arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text: APNE BANDHE HAATHO KO, BIMAAR-KE ZEWARKO\nBHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: MY BOUND HANDS AND THE SHACKLES OF THE SICK,\nI WILL NEVER FORGET

arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text:
UTHTI HUI AANDHI KO, MEHSHAT KO BAYAABAKO
CHUPTE HUWE SURAJ KO, TAARIKI KO MAYDAAKO
CHALTE HUWE KHANJAR KO
NEZE PE TERE SAR KO...
english translation text:
THE RISING SANDSTORMS, THE BARREN LAND
THE HIDING SUN, THE DARKNESS OF THE NIGHT
THE STRIKING DAGGERS, THE HEAD ON THE SPEAR…
I WILL NEVER FORGET

arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text:
EK CHAND THA BADLIME, CHUPTA THA NIKAL TATHA
PARDA DARE KHAYMA KA, UTHTA KABHI GIRTA THA
WO KHAIMAA E LAILA SE
HAYE RUKHSATE AKBAR KO...
english translation text: THE MOON WAS BASHFUL, IT KEPT ON COMING AND GOING,\nTHE DOOR OF THE TENTS, WOULD OPEN AND CLOSE,\nSHE DID NOT FORGET THE TIME WHEN AKBAR DEPARTED FROM THE TENT

arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text:
FIZZA KO MERA BHAYI, MAA KEHKE BULA TA THA,
GHAM USKA MERE BHAYI, YE NAAM PE JATAA THA
RUTBAY MEIN JO MAA BAN KAR
AYI USI MADAR KO
english translation text: MY BROTHER USED TO TREAT FIZZA AS HIS MOTHER,\nHER SORROW O’ MY BROTHER AT THE MENTION OF HER NAME,\nI DID NOT FORGET THE SIGHT OF HER IN THE COURT

arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text:
LEHRATE HUWE NEZA, AUR SHIMR KA WO BARNA
AA AAKE MERE PEECHE, HAR BIBI KA WO CHUPNA
SHOLO ME GIRE GHARKO
CHINTI HUWI CHAADER KO
english translation text:
THE SWAYING SPEARS AND THE ADVANCES OF SHIMR,
ALL THE WOMEN COVERED BEHIND ME,
SHE DID NOT FORGET THE HOUSE ENGULFED IN FLAMS
AND THE SNATCHED HIJABS

arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text:
YAAD ATA HAI EK MAA KA, WO KHAAK ME DAS JANA
AUR AAG KE SHOLO ME, WO MAA KA JULAS JANA
JALTE HUWE JULESE
LIPTI HUWI MADAR KO
english translation text: I RECALL THE FALLING OF A MOTHER INTO THE DUST,\nIN THE FLAMES THE MOTHER WAS ENGULFED,\nSHE DID NOT FORGET THE SCENE OF A MOTHER CLUTCHING DESPERATELY TO THE BURNING CRIB

arabic text: BAAZAR KE MANZAR KO, AUR APNE KHULE SAR\nKO BHULI NAHI MAI
english translation text: I WILL NEVER FORGET THE SCENES OF THE MARKET, AND OUR UNCOVERED HEADS

arabic text:
HAI AAJ BHI WO GIRYAA, HAI AAJ BHI WO ZAARI
HAI AAJ BHI PATHAR KE, SIN-E SE LAHU JAARI
ROTE HUWE PATHAR KO
PATHAR PE RAKHE SARKO, BHULI
english translation text: TILL THIS DAY THERE IS MOURNING AND LAMENTATION,\nEVEN TODAY BLOOD FLOWS FROM THE STONE,\nSHE DID NOT FORGET THE CRYING STONES AND A HEAD ON THESE STONE
